record.title: DfCM current frontier
record.body: R47 materially advances the reachable frontier: the R46 cross-repository compiler now has a 50-court fail-closed qualification layer and an upstream-corrected real-ggen template path, merged at marketplace main b942ff54f7d00e376dd2f28beb930390f4feb97b. Immediate frontier is no longer producer qualification. It is independent external consumer realization: (1) re-resolve and execute the compiled ggen target, (2) re-resolve and execute the compiled chatgpt-cloud-elixir target, (3) bind independent consumer receipts/evidence roots, (4) expand exact repository census beyond three grounded targets, (5) measure consumer replication R separately from 50x qualification reuse, (6) use Project memory causally in the next run so M becomes observed rather than UNKNOWN, then (7) retry 1000X admission. Weakest multiplier is external consumer realization; Project PRE leverage was unavailable this run.
